### Changes Made to `src/metrics/analytics/export.rs`:

   - `tss: f32` - Training Stress Score

   - `ctl: f32` - Chronic Training Load (42-day EWMA)
   - `tsb: f32` - Training Stress Balance (CTL - ATL)
   - `acwr: Option<f32>` - Optional ACWR (skipped in JSON when None)

- `DailyLoadExport::new()` - Create without ACWR
- `DailyLoadExport::with_acwr()` - Create with explicit ACWR
- `DailyLoadExport::from_daily_load()` - Convert from `DailyLoad` with auto-calculated ACWR
- `TrainingLoadExport::from_days()` - Create from unsorted entries (auto-sorts)
- `TrainingLoadExport::date_range()` - Get start/end dates
- `AnalyticsExport::with_training_load()` - Builder method

- Tests for all constructors and methods
